user.title: Connect a JugglucoNG phone
user.description: Home Assistant will receive glucose data from JugglucoNG on this phone. Give the phone a name, such as My phone. Add each phone separately.

receiver.title: Set up the connection
receiver.description:
Finish setup in Home Assistant, then open API destinations in JugglucoNG and add Glucifer HA. Scan the QR code below or paste this connection URL:

`{url}`

If only a path is shown, add your Home Assistant URL before it. Keep the URL and QR code private. To connect away from home, use a reachable HTTPS address or VPN and leave Accept local requests only turned off.

init.title: Phone connection settings
init.description:
In JugglucoNG, open the Glucifer HA destination under API destinations. Scan the QR code below or paste this connection URL:

`{url}`

If only a path is shown, add your Home Assistant URL before it. Choose which data to send in JugglucoNG. Keep the URL and QR code private. Removing this integration entry disconnects this phone.

rotate.title: Replace the connection URL
rotate.description:
Submit to activate this new connection URL and disable the old one. Then update the Glucifer HA destination in JugglucoNG using the QR code below or this URL. Your entities and stored readings are kept.

`{url}`

Keep the URL and QR code private.
